test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Four students M, N, O, and P are standing in a queue in a restaurant to give their orders. M is not behind O but behind P. O does not give the last order. Who is standing in front of the queue?
solution:
Four students M, N, O, and P are standing in a queue in a restaurant to give their orders.

1) M is not behind O but behind P.

P > M > O

2) O does not give the last order.

P > M > O > N

∴ Here, 'P' is standing in front of the queue.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**
